shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in components/AppProvider.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js' styles/globals.css; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('styles/globals.css')
s = p.read_text().replace('button,\\na.button {', 'button,\\na.button,\\n.post-card a.button {').replace('button:hover,\\na.button:hover {', 'button:hover,\\na.button:hover,\\n.post-card a.button:hover {').replace('  background: #0051a2;\\n}', '  background: #0051a2;\\n  color: white;\\n}')
p.write_text(s)
PY
node --input-type=module <<'JS'
const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:3100'
const checks = [
  ['home', '/', { headers: { 'user-agent': 'MigrationTest/1.0' } }, 200, ['Welcome to My Blog', 'MigrationTest/1.0', 'Home - My Blog']],
  ['blog', '/blog', {}, 200, ['All Blog Posts', 'Blog - My Blog', 'Read More']],
  ['prebuilt post', '/blog/1', {}, 200, ['Comments (5)', 'sunt aut facere repellat provident occaecati excepturi optio reprehenderit']],
  ['on-demand post', '/blog/11', {}, 200, ['Comments (5)', 'et ea vero quia laudantium autem']],
  ['missing post', '/blog/9999', {}, 404, ['404 - Page Not Found']],
  ['unknown route', '/no-such-route', {}, 404, ['404 - Page Not Found']],
  ['explicit 404', '/404', {}, 404, ['404 - Page Not Found']],
  ['list api', '/api/posts', {}, 200, ['First Post', 'Second Post']],
  ['create api', '/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({title:'Test', content:'Body'}) }, 201, ['Test', 'Body', 'createdAt']],
  ['invalid create', '/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' }, 400, ['Title and content are required']],
  ['get api', '/api/posts/42', {}, 200, ['Post 42', 'createdAt']],
  ['update api', '/api/posts/42', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({title:'Changed'}) }, 200, ['Changed', 'Updated content for post 42']],
  ['delete api', '/api/posts/42', { method: 'DELETE' }, 200, ['Post 42 deleted successfully']],
  ['unsupported api method', '/api/posts', { method: 'PUT' }, 405, ['Method PUT Not Allowed']],
]
let failures = 0
for (const [name, path, options, status, snippets] of checks) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(base + path, options)
    const body = await response.text()
    const missing = snippets.filter((snippet) => "'!body.includes(snippet))
    const ok = response.status === status && missing.length === 0 && (name !== '"'unsupported api method' || response.headers.get('allow') === 'GET, POST')
    console.log("'`${ok ? '"'PASS' : 'FAIL'} "'${name}: HTTP ${response.status}${missing.length ? `, missing ${missing.join('"', ')}"'` : '"''}"'`)
    if (!ok) failures++
  } catch (error) { console.log(`FAIL ${name}: ${error}`); failures++ }
}
process.exitCode = failures ? 1 : 0
JS'
